notes.title: CBS Channel 8 Segment on Dotware Games
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31003948/6537bc3ce0cd78f0a3060f24c585a8650eb7854f.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31003948/5192e9bfd6891e2f5c055bdb00c96b89d789f0d7.png[/img][/url]

I just did a TV interview with CBS for Channel 8 here in Las Vegas about Dotware Games and how I'm trying to build a pool of talented game designers locally. 

There is a glimpse of [i]Akhenaten: Rule as Pharaoh[/i] gameplay at the end of the video ;)

notes.title: Akhenaten: Rule as Pharaoh | Early Screenshots (2019)
notes.notes:
We've made a gallery of new screenshots to showcase how the project is looking so far in development, including general graphics and a peak at the Edict system

[b][h1][url=https://imgur.com/a/hhQV0Vw] Akhenaten: Rule as Pharaoh | Early Screenshots (2019) [/url][/h1][/b]
We'll be communicating much more than we have been from this point forward, and have posted an explanation for the delays as well as our commitment to being actively involved in the community from now on:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/719160/discussions/0/1741103267313397900/

notes.title: First Gameplay to Debut at NAB Show in Las Vegas
notes.notes:
We said more great things were to come, and here they are:

[i]Akhenaten: Rule as Pharaoh[/i] will be debuting at the [url=https://www.nabshow.com/show-floor/attractions-pavilions/game-developers-gallery] Game Developers' Gallery [/url] in Las Vegas, NV April 9 - 12th at the NAB Show Convention. 

A demo build of the game will be playable by attendees at Dotware's game exhibit.

Furthermore, we're happy to announce we've made a decision on early access: We will release in Early Access. No date has been set for this just yet, but expect more updates to follow NAB Show.

Dotware Games

notes.title: Official Announcement: "Akhenaten: Rule as Pharaoh" to debut on Steam!
notes.notes:
Today we officially launch the announcement of [i]Akhenaten: Rule as Pharaoh[/i], a high graphics strategy game for PC and Mac that takes you to the world's oldest open sandbox, the deserts of Ancient Egypt, and places you at the helm of all power and prestige - Pharaoh. 

Our announcement trailer [url=https://youtu.be/b4N8B2G_dv8] can be found here on Youtube[/url]

Expect more great things soon,

~ Developer, Dotware
www.DotwareGames.com
